name: Bally Astrocade
significance: Possessed the most advanced color bitmapped graphics of any early second-generation machine, introducing true arcade-quality visuals to early home systems.

editorialContent.overview: A sophisticated hybrid console/computer system boasting authentic arcade graphics and built-in BASIC programming capabilities.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Possessed the most advanced color bitmapped graphics of any early second-generation machine, introducing true arcade-quality visuals to early home systems.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Pistol-grip controllers with 8-way joystick and rotating top paddle dial
